name: expat-savings-rates
description: Compares published savings and fixed-deposit rates at offshore banks open to expats, with minimum deposit, eligibility, deposit protection and the date each rate was read.

interface.longDescription: Choose a currency, account type and amount. See published rates from HSBC Expat, Standard Chartered Jersey, Skipton International, Barclays International and others, read from each bank's own page and dated. Accounts not open to your country of residence are removed. Each result shows the minimum deposit, who can open it and the compensation scheme that protects it. General information only, not personalised advice.
defaultPrompt: Best 12-month GBP fixed deposit for an expat living in Malaysia?
Where can I earn interest on USD 50,000 offshore? I live in Dubai.
How much of my savings is protected in a Jersey bank?
